edition: Unofficial House Correspondence and Visitors Glulx

overrides.description: Retain every qualified Release 1222 layer, assign Release 1223, and load deterministic correspondence and visitors
Add packed queue state, unique physical letters, provenance, one reusable fixed reply card, missed notices, two exterior visitors, and recap

preserved_canonical_state: the canonical West of House, anchored MAILBOX, original ADVERTISEMENT leaflet, boarded front door, room exits, and score remain authoritative
each letter, reply card, visitor notice, receipt, tag, courier, and surveyor is one exact physical object and is never cloned
authored queue triggers derive from existing Cellar intrusion, museum theft, and repaired-dam state
bounded replies use one reusable fixed-text card and unambiguous RESPOND TO grammar rather than free-form composition
ordinary TELL engages a present visitor instead of competing with canonical ANSWER grammar
the mutable packed mail table is constant-addressed to avoid consuming another global while remaining native-save persistent
visitor bit clearing uses known-present power-of-two subtraction rather than nonportable complement operations
visitor arrival defers across real departure so absence produces a physical missed notice before one bounded return
visitors remain exterior because the canonical boarded front door does not open
missed visits leave physical records and at most one bounded return opportunity
native save and restore preserve queue order, object custody, replies, notices, visitors, and completion state without repair
excluded_scope: free-form mail composition or open-ended dialogue
generic message or NPC scheduling systems
duplicate mail, regenerated destroyed mail, or parallel mailbox inventory
automatic front-door opening or fabricated entry routes
unbounded visitors, repeated farming, or visitor combat
automatic archive creation before the Attic archive train
new score or automatic puzzle completion
sub-beads or a parallel planning hierarchy
